description: This file defines the 'UserAuthProvider' entity class for a Doctrine ORM-based PHP project, representing user authentication providers with properties such as provider type, LDAP details, and associated user.

classes.name: UserAuthProvider
classes.description: Entity class mapping to 'ohrm_user_auth_provider' table, representing external user authentication providers with localized constants for provider types.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the UserAuthProvider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the UserAuthProvider.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this provider.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the provider type, e.g., local or LDAP.

methods.name: getLDAPUserHash
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user hash if applicable.

methods.name: getLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user unique ID.

methods.name: setLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user unique ID.
